_comment: Metres per tile, per layer, in the order the loader binds them:
0 ground (dirt_floor), 1 rock (brown_mud_03, wet mud), 2 high (leafy_grass), 3 sediment (rocky_trail_02).
Physical sizes from each Poly Haven asset page, not taste.
This set is named by a scene's terrain.textures; the project's shared set stays in textures/terrain.
